name: April
source: Alex's neighbor. She's bold, energetic, and flirty, but don't let her outgo- ing personality and audacious fashion sense fool you. April is an exceptionally intelligent girl and always gets what she wants, no matter the cost. If you decide to date her, know that it's a one-way ticket... But who knows, maybe she has a gentler side to her, too?
